summary: Compete in the Mutant Fighting Cup to win the World Cup
description:
Mutant Fighting Cup - Classic Edition time to Unleash the Beasts! Dive into a world where mutated creatures battle for supremacy.

Remember the heart-pounding, adrenaline-filled battles from the classic mobile game "Mutant Fighting Cup"? It's back and better than ever - now without any ads to interrupt your brawling experience!

Game Features:

* Monstrous Mutations: Create your own unique mutant using a combination of genes, merging the DNA of different animals and unleashing hybrid fighters with extraordinary abilities.
* Epic Battles: Test your mutant's might against ferocious opponents in strategic turn-based combat. Every choice you make can be the difference between victory and defeat.
* Diverse Arenas: Battle across a variety of arenas, each with its own challenges and obstacles. Adapt, strategize, and prove your mutant's dominance.
* Global Domination: Compete against players from all over the world. Earn your place at the top of the global leaderboards.
* Classic Mode: Relive the original game in all its glory, brought to life with improved graphics and optimized for the latest devices.

No Ads, Pure Action: In this Classic Edition, we've stripped away all the ads. Pay once and play without interruptions. Dive straight into the action and immerse yourself in a world of mutant battles.

Whether you're a long-time fan or new to the world of "Mutant Fighting Cup", prepare for an intense fighting adventure. Ready your mutant and let the battles begin!
